what: 168Railway: which lintas of the `indo` template are double track (GAPEKA 2026 network, as of late 2026). Everything not listed is single track. A lintas runs between two GAPEKA station codes along the line a GAPEKA train takes between them (pipeline/indo_tracks.py), so it is the same along its whole length. Correct a row and rebuild (realnet.py net/geom, realcorridors, indo_tracks.py, realsave, gamesave). `check: true` = the owner should confirm.
